reader.requirement: At --std 85, files (in the Sort-Merge module, a sort or merge file among them) named in one SAME RECORD AREA clause share one record area, left-aligned as an implicit redefinition, so a record moved, released, read or returned through one file's record-name is the content of every other member's records, whatever their lengths, with all members open at once.
reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|ConstructRegistry|DialectLevel|CobolVersion' over FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs (only Edition.At / Edition.Error diagnostic positioning and emission, no switch; none inside LinkSameRecordArea, lines 560-600) and FileModel.cs SameRecordAreaPeers/AreaFiles (none); SequentialIoEmitter's SAME RECORD AREA arm (ReleasedRecordNeedsAlsoAvailable) reads only the model. The seed DataBinder.cs#BindIoControl is a call site (line 579, inside BindDeclarations), not a member.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb235 shares the area between two sequential FDs (READ, CLOSE); it does not exercise the Sort-Merge module's form (an SD in the clause, RELEASE/RETURN and SORT USING through the shared area), records of different lengths, or a variable-length (ODO) sort record.

reader.notes: The clause records its members once (SameClauses) and LinkSameRecordArea joins their records into one implicit-redefinition class; out-of-line (variable-length) records get the emitted also-available store. The probes cover the SD form, the mixed lengths and an ODO sort record, all left-aligned in one area.

refuter.evidence: r5org.cob at --std 85 (refute-1985-033/r5org-002), the organizations the reader did not try (SR6): SAME RECORD AREA FOR an SD, an INDEXED (dynamic) file and a RELATIVE (random) file, with records of 6, 6 and 8 characters. Printed 'VIA-RL S-KEY=22 S-TXT=BBBB' (a MOVE to the longer relative record is the sort record, left-aligned), 'RETURNED IX-REC=22BBBB RL-A=22BBBB' / '11AAAA' (DESCENDING order; the returned record seen through both FD records), 'AFTER-WRITE S-REC=22BBBB FS=00' (the written indexed record still available through the area), 'READ-IX S-REC=22BBBB RL-A=22BBBB FS=00' (a random READ of the indexed file is the content of the other members), 'READ-RL S-REC=22BBBB IX-REC=22BBBB RL-B=[ZZ]'. A first run (r5org-001) was refused COBOL0863 for a numeric RECORD KEY, correct at 85 (§1985:IX.2.7.3 SR2), and the key was made PIC X(2). cite.py: OK §1985:XI.2.5.4 GR1 the text is in GR1; OK §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR6.
